answer: Zero-knowledge uniqueness proofs stop Sybils in four steps. First, one personhood check gives each operator a private credential, never on chain. Second, each registration proves in zero knowledge its credential is fresh and unused, catching copies without naming anyone. Third, proofs enter a public atlas, so reuse shows at once. Fourth, a forged proof burns a $30 bond and bans it two years. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 credentials at $40 each plus $30,000 in bonds, all lost if caught. Trust grows like a grove at dawn: each tree stands alone, as neighbours know every face at market.
